outcome: Let a governed CyberAlchemy Context request and consume a challengeable ontology projection calculated deterministically from canonical per-node and per-relation events at one exact event cut, while preserving authority boundaries and rejecting stale, mixed, missing, or unverifiable cuts.
scope: Product meaning for one CyberAlchemy ontology-runtime integration epoch: context-framed projection consumption, exact-cut traceability, deterministic replay expectation, challengeability, and fail-closed invalid-cut behavior.
exclusions: making a Context, projection, snapshot, index, compiled graph, or system ontology a canonical event source
defining capability-local business contracts reserved for D65-S3
selecting a compiler, adapter, storage engine, transport, API, UI, or Rust realization
changing or re-accepting the frozen W8 technical baseline
claiming implementation, conformance, runtime behavior, migration, cutover, publication, release, or deployment

lifecycle_posture.provenance: exact D65-S1 owner selection plus Product Thesis and Goal

challenge_route: Challenge product outcome and value through the CyberAlchemy v2 product owner, selected meaning through definitions-governance, ontology shape and admission through the product-ontology owner, Context suitability through its consumer owner, and runtime assumptions through the separate W8 and later D65 owner routes.
claim_limit: Authored Product Capability candidate and product-ontology meaning only; not adopted, admitted, business-modeled, realized, conformant, migrated, cut over, published, released, or deployed.
